details: Cryptocurrencies tumbled over the weekend, with Bitcoin dropping below $63,000 and Ethereum falling to $1,731, reaching their lowest levels since August and July respectively. This downturn was fueled by accelerated liquidations of leveraged long positions, with roughly $1.9 billion in crypto positions wiped out in 24 hours.
title: Crypto Market Plunges: Bitcoin at 3-Month Low

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded $185.45 million in net outflows on Friday, extending their withdrawal streak to seven consecutive trading sessions. Cumulative outflows since November 5 have reached approximately $1.91 billion, signaling continued institutional selling pressure on Bitcoin's price.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Seventh Straight Day of Outflows

details: The crypto market is experiencing "extreme fear," with the Crypto Fear and Greed Index at 13, driven by expectations of higher Federal Reserve interest rates, an "AI-fueled risk-off mood," and the ongoing fallout from the recent $6 billion Binance hack. These factors have contributed to Bitcoin's 25% slump since October 21.
title: Macro Factors & Binance Hack Fuel Crypto Market Fear
